entities.title: The handshake reply is decoded byte by byte
entities.summary: Proxy.Hello turns each byte of the daemon's reply into a char, so non-ASCII text in an error, such as a root path, is garbled.
entities.expected: The error the daemon sends (for example "not a directory: <path>" for a path with non-ASCII characters) reaches the serve process's standard error as sent.
entities.observed: Proxy.Hello appends (char)b for every byte read until the newline, so each multi-byte UTF-8 character becomes several Latin-1 characters in the message serve prints.
acceptanceCriteria: The reply line is decoded as UTF-8, and a test with a non-ASCII root path checks the message.

origin.description: Found while documenting the folder, by reading Proxy.Hello; not reproduced.
